headline: Amber Rose opened up about why dating has been difficult for her, saying a lot of men look
body: Amber Rose opened up about why dating has been difficult for her, saying a lot of men look at her exes and instantly feel like they can’t measure up. She explained that some start to self‑sabotage because they assume she expects the same lifestyle — when in reality, she has her own money and only wants genuine love and good character.

source_caption_text:
Amber Rose opened up about why dating has been difficult for her, saying a lot of men look at her exes and instantly feel like they can’t measure up.

She explained that some start to self‑sabotage because they assume she expects the same lifestyle — when in reality, she has her own money and only wants genuine love and good character.

Amber said:
“Men will look at my exes for an example and be like, ‘I can’t give her that,’ so they self‑sabotage… when really I don’t need anything from you. I don’t need you to come into my life as a millionaire.”
